interpretation_limits: The teardown DMA timeout and later early-boot marker are different phases; no causal link is established.
Timeout mode 0 means queue-not-full check. It can fail before the first block or later in the transfer; the number of submitted blocks is unknown.
This invocation returns before PKC setup and StartCpu; it did not demonstrate execution of the requested FWSEC-SB program.
Raw firmware return codes are not given NV_STATUS names. Early-gate PRI semantics remain unnamed where no GA102 proof exists.
source_mismatch_notes: Envytools GF100 PCLOCK domain is not a proven GA102 field definition for 0x137090.
NVIDIA Hopper/Blackwell I2CS scratch and Linux nvgrace HBM-training uses of 0x200bc are not GA102 semantic proof.
No identified retained register value selects one of the modeled failure paths.
